Subject: Triggered drawdown orchestration and local tax ops

Hi Elena / Brightline team —

Following our contract signature, we want to lock the operational flow for the annual prepay and the monthly triggered drawdown mechanics so finance can start automated invoices next month. Summary and asks below.

Summary (proposal):
- Commitment: $480k annual prepay (already authorized).
- Drawdown cadence: monthly triggered withdrawals on the 1st of each month (40k/mo) with a reserve sweep after quarter-end.
- Invoicing: Redwood will issue tax invoices per country; we propose Redwood Europe BV as the issuing entity for EU flows.
- Escrow/collection: funds sweep from Brightline operating account to Redwood escrow intermediary then netted to our ledger weekly.

Immediate asks (needed to start collection automation):
1) Banking: confirm the Brightline collection account (IBAN + beneficiary name) for the sweep.
2) VAT evidence: please provide VAT registration docs or certificate for any EU entities that will receive services (Italy + Germany if applicable).
3) PO number: confirm the PO format you want on invoices (we can prefix invoices with your PO or use RINF-PR as invoice prefix).

Attached: invoice_schedule_v1.xlsx (draft drawing and invoice schedule).

Target timeline:
- By EOD Fri: banking & VAT docs
- Next Wed: first automated invoice generated for May 1 drawdown

If you're ok with this path we will: 1) have Finance create monthly recurring invoices, 2) enable the sweep automation with Treasury, and 3) route invoices from Redwood Europe BV for Brightline EU entities to minimize VAT friction.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the clear plan, this looks good in general. Quick clarifications from our tax and treasury teams:

- Will the Redwood Europe BV invoices be VAT inclusive or will they apply reverse-charge for B2B? Our Italian team prefers reverse-charge when possible but will need the invoice wording and VAT numbers to be correct.
- For the sweep: will Brightline see a single net amount from escrow, or separate line items per month? We need to reconcile on our side with our accounting system.
- Attached is our sample PO and our Italian VAT certificate (sample_po.pdf).

A couple of asks:
1) Please send a sample invoice PDF with the full legal wording you plan to use so our tax advisor can confirm reverse-charge handling.
2) If you intend to change issuing entity mid-year, we need a signed amendment.

Quote of your point: "route invoices from Redwood Europe BV for Brightline EU entities to minimize VAT friction." — if that's the approach, please share the exact legal entity details and tax ID.

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance Ops, Brightline Finance

Elena / Irene —

Short answer on the VAT routing and invoicing mechanics: we can support both approaches depending on the receiving country and your preference. A few operational notes:

1) Reverse-charge vs VAT-inclusive:
- For B2B transactions where Brightline provides a valid VAT ID (Italy/Germany), Redwood Europe BV invoices can be issued with reverse-charge wording and no VAT charged. We will include the buyer VAT ID and the phrase required under Italian law.
- If Brightline prefers to have no reliance on reverse-charge for certain entities, we can issue VAT-inclusive invoices from local Redwood subsidiary (this requires a PO/contract amendment).

2) Sweep visibility:
- Treasury will configure the sweep to show a single net debit per month to Brightline; we will log itemized ledger entries in the invoice PDF and the automated email so reconciliation works for you.

3) Legal & tax fields:
- We need Brightline legal name, VAT ID, and registered address for the invoice header; we will mirror exactly what you provide.

Next steps I propose (quick technical ops):
- Irene: once we receive VAT cert + PO format, Finance will generate a sample invoice PDF and send to Elena's tax advisor (target: EOD Thu).
- Treasury (me): I will coordinate with your bank to confirm the sweep beneficiary and whether the net amount appears as a single ledger item.

FYI Grace — please queue the sample invoice generation and include invoice prefix RINF-PR- in the sample so Elena can confirm numbering.

Vivek
Director, Treasury & Payments
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick summary and confirmations so we have a single source of truth:

Decisions:
- Drawdown cadence: monthly on the 1st (40k per month starting 2027-05-01).
- Issuing entity for EU: Redwood Europe BV will issue invoices to Brightline EU legal entities and will apply reverse-charge where Brightline supplies a valid VAT ID.
- Sweep behavior: Brightline will see a single net debit per month; itemized lines will be embedded in the invoice PDF for reconciliation.

Actions and owners:
- Brightline (Elena): share the VAT certificate(s), legal billing address, and PO number format by EOD Fri.
- Grace (Redwood): produce sample invoice PDF (prefix RINF-PR-) and final_schedule_v2.xlsx with the confirmed monthly dates.
- Vivek / Treasury: confirm bank sweep routing and provide the beneficiary IBAN to Brightline by early next week.

Attachments: final_schedule_v2.xlsx (updated with agreed cadence and invoice numbering).

Elena — once we have the documents from you, Grace will send the sample invoice for tax sign-off and we'll kick off the first automated invoice run. If you need an amendment to the SOW to lock Redwood Europe BV as the issuing entity, flag it and we'll loop Legal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
